subject: Student Advisory Council Policy Proposals
overview: The School Committee met with the Student Advisory Council for the first time to review student-led initiatives regarding school rules and academic workload. The committee discussed student proposals to reform homework time limits and the backpack ban, referring the matters to the School Site Council for handbook revision consideration.

items.title: Roll Call and Introductions
items.summary: Members and students introduced themselves and shared their primary motivations for participating in the advisory body.

items.title: Homework Policy Proposal
items.summary: Students presented a draft policy recommending specific time limits for homework assignments to help balance academic demands with extracurricular activities and mental health.

items.title: Backpack Policy Discussion
items.summary: The body addressed student concerns regarding the current backpack ban, citing logistical challenges including short transition times and the physical strain of carrying heavy materials.

items.title: Council Representation and Handbook Inclusion
items.summary: Students proposed formally defining the advisory council's role in the student handbook and explored options for expanding the number of student representatives.
